reports.title: A strange clue, or a patched bug?
reports.summary: The latest official Steam patch notes address misleading evidence behaviour and several camera problems.
body: The developer reports fixes for the Monkey Paw knowledge wish crossing out correct evidence, UV fingerprints failing to charge on Willow and Nell's Diner, and several black video-camera screen conditions.

Player impact (analysis): before treating an equipment failure as a ghost tell, confirm your game is updated and repeat the test. The Prison entrance also gains more interactions and fingerprint opportunities.
This launch summary is checked against the official Steam announcement dated 10 September. It is not a claim that Ghost Hub independently reproduced every fix.

reports.title: Smaller routes. A better shared journal.
reports.summary: Quality of Life Part 2 introduces restricted versions of Prison, Brownstone High School and Point Hope.
body: Kinetic and its Steam announcement describe three restricted map variants, duplicate-capture indicators, and visibility of teammates' evidence and ghost selections in the journal.
Player impact (analysis): agree which map variant the team selected before using an old route guide. Compare journal selections instead of assuming everyone recorded the same clue.

A subsequent September patch revises several issues from this release. Consult the newer report before relying on the original known-issues list. These are two official posts about one release, not independent gameplay tests.

sources.title: Kinetic Games: Quality of Life Part 2

reports.title: Willow has changed. So should your route.
reports.summary: The reworked 13 Willow Street and a new ghost make older routes and evidence charts worth revisiting.
body: The July quality-of-life release reworks 13 Willow Street and introduces the Deildegast. Treat pre-update location guides as historical until their layouts have been checked.

For investigators: confirm equipment controls and review the new ghost's evidence before interpreting an unfamiliar combination as a bug. This is Ghost Hub's practical interpretation of the announced changes.

reports.title: The road to 1.0: quality comes first.
reports.summary: Kinetic's revised outlook moves 1.0 to 2027 and puts fixes and quality-of-life work at the centre of 2026.
body: Kinetic Games' revised outlook places Phasmophobia 1.0 in 2027, with quality-of-life work and an engine update forming part of the intervening plans.
For players: older release-roadmap graphics should not be treated as current commitments. Plans describe intent, not a shipped game feature.

reports.title: Three clues. One very convincing impostor.
reports.summary: Why The Mimic stays in your candidate list when ghost orbs seem to rule it out.
body: The Mimic has its own evidence combination and produces extra ghost orbs. Those orbs sit outside the difficulty's normal evidence allowance, including on zero-evidence contracts.
Ghost Hub checks possible evidence sets rather than simply matching three checkboxes. Behavioural tells still need context because The Mimic can copy another ghost's behaviour.
